results.reasoning: Re-judged headless on the scratch copy sitting-0914 (WALKDOWN_HOME=<copy>/home, no server touched). In the copy's feature YAML I removed the signoff line from time.records.stored-as-utc, set time.records.read-in-your-zone to `signoff: [product]`, and set status.derived.latest-wins to `signoff: []`. `status --json` (signoff-defaults-status-extract.txt) derives acceptance roles of [eng], [eng, product] and [eng] respectively - every list contains eng, and the declared product role is kept beside it rather than dropped. `lint` (signoff-defaults-lint.txt) raises a [signoff] warning on the product-only file ('omits eng, but engineering always signs - the file says something the report will not do') and a separate [signoff] warning on the empty list ('omit it to mean [eng], which is what it means anyway'), so neither misleading file is silently repaired; the rule with no signoff line draws no finding, as it should. The tagged tests in test/tiers.test.js and test/lint.test.js pass (3/3 for this rule) and cover default, order preservation, eng insertion, the omits-eng warning and the unknown-role case. The copy's edits were reverted after judging.
